failure_or_lesson: A live edge-to-canonical happy path does not demonstrate that an unacknowledged device event survives process interruption. Keep a separate pending-event probe across a real service restart.
goal: Demonstrate that a pending device event remains in the selected JetStream plane through a service restart and is committed to KurrentDB before acknowledgment.
notes: One-device restart recovery passed; device-clock conflict resolution remains unqualified.
procedure: Publish a synthetic metadata-only device packet to a durable host stream; verify it is pending and absent from KurrentDB; restart NATS alongside authority services; reconnect a fresh reconciler, consume the packet, and verify one exact KurrentDB event.
validation: Real-backend run 36572682119 passed the pending JetStream event restart probe and exact KurrentDB commit after recovery.
